description: Implementation of rx_buffer_pool functionality, including reservation, slot processing, and pool management for radio buffer handling in a wireless communication system.

classes.name: rx_buffer_pool_impl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of rx_buffer_pool managing buffer reservations, expirations, and slot processing.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves a buffer for a given slot, identifier, and codeblocks, handling retransmissions and buffer availability.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Processes buffers at a given slot, expiring or freeing buffers as needed.

methods.name: get_pool
methods.description: Returns a reference to the pool object itself.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the buffer pool, preventing further reservations and ensuring all buffers are unlocked.
